newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish PM confirms Handlowy sale in eight weeks.
newsitem.headline: Polish PM confirms Handlowy sale in eight weeks.

text.p: Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz on Thursday said the privatisation of Poland's biggest commercial Bank Handlowy SA by the end of June was on track.
"Bank Handlowy will likely be privatised within the next eight weeks," Cimoszewicz told Reuters in an interview.
The finance ministry has recently said that under the privatisation plan the public offering would be divided equally into institutional and retail tranches. @

The shares would represent 30 percent equity in the bank after a planned 112 million zloty share capital increase to facilitate a convertible bond issue designed to help finance Poland's social security reform.
Before the public offering Bank Handlowy is due to offer 42.9 percent of its present shares to a group of selected international financial institutions.
